text:
sara: Heads-up — my PR #3472 (migration guide) is failing docs CI: linkcheck + vale. Hoping to get a tiny patch merged in today's 16:00 UTC merge window. Anyone free to review?

jon: I can take a look after lunch. Can you paste the CI output?

docs-ci-bot: ```
=== LinkCheck ===
ERROR: docs/migration.md:42 -> https://old-example.com/legacy-mig -> HTTP 404

=== VALE ===
docs/migration.md:41: 'WeaselWords' - Avoid words like "basically" (style/weasel.yml)
```

sara: Thanks — both are tiny. The link should point to the new doc location (we renamed the section). Also remove the word "basically" and rephrase.

maria: I can pick this up, 20m ETA. Will try to keep it to a single commit.

jon: If it's small we can merge in the 16:00 slot, ping me when it's ready.

maria: Pushed a microfix in branch docs/3472-linkfix. Diff below:

```diff
--- a/docs/migration.md
+++ b/docs/migration.md
@@ -39,8 +39,8 @@
-For most users, the old runtime is basically compatible.
+For most users, the old runtime remains compatible.

-See https://old-example.com/legacy-mig for details.
+See /docs/migration#legacy for details.
```

sara: Looks good. Can you run `make docs-preview` locally and confirm linkcheck passes? Also add a very short changelog line (cherry-pickable).

maria: Ran `make docs-preview` and linkcheck passes locally. Added changelog note and pushed commit 5a1b2c.

docs-ci-bot: Triggered CI for commit 5a1b2c...
docs-ci-bot: ```
LinkCheck: PASS
VALE: PASS
md-lint: PASS
```

jon: Reviewed and approved. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks both — I'll queue for merge in the 16:00 UTC merge window.

release-bot: Merged PR #3472 to main at 16:02 UTC (commit 5a1b2c)

maria: Nice, thanks! :tada: 

sara: Closing loop — QA verified the migration doc renders correctly in the staging preview. All good.
